subject.title: Feature: durable natural-language rule learning + explicit multi-mention reply semantics

question: Should OpenClaw add a core governed durable conversational rule layer and cross-channel explicit multi-mention reply contract, or keep durable rule learning in memory/plugins while fixing only channel-specific mention bugs?
rationale: This changes rule authority between AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, session history, plugin memory, storage migrations, and channel reply semantics; automation cannot safely choose that product boundary.

options.title: Design a narrow core contract
options.body: Define rule authority, conflict precedence, storage, migration, and explicit multi-mention semantics before implementation starts.

options.title: Keep rule learning plugin-owned
options.body: Use memory plugins, Dreaming, skills, or ClawHub packages for durable conversational learning and keep core focused on extension seams.

options.title: Only fix channel bugs
options.body: Treat the durable rule layer as out of scope for now and track Feishu message loss through the narrower canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Design a narrow core contract
recommendation.body: Define rule authority, conflict precedence, storage, migration, and explicit multi-mention semantics before implementation starts.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest overlap across active-memory, Dreaming, and Feishu mention-history evidence.
